items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: I’d play the guitar and do an Elvis Presley tune or something

ctx.x: I was going to say, were you a bit of a — have some notoriety in school because of your talents?

It was neat. You know I always say middle school is not generally the best period for most people, it’s just weird. Yeah let’s just get a bunch of people who have their hormones all over the place and put them in a building together. You know? It’s just a bad idea. But yeah I would play for the school, either play the clarinet or I’d play the guitar and do an Elvis Presley tune or something, and that seemed to help me make friends. And then my friends at school would come out and see me play wherever I was…

If you went to a gathering, a cocktail party or something and you didn’t really know anybody and you met a new person and they say, “Well what do you do for a living, Dave?” Do you have a short answer?
